projects.name: VMS Careline
projects.what: The website and brand structure for VMS Careline, a healthcare e-commerce business in India.
projects.problem: Two kinds of customers, one tangled site. Products were hard to find, and enquiries had no clear path to a reply.
projects.built: Two separate verticals: VMS Careline and VMS Cart. A store built around how people choose products. An automated path from first enquiry to follow-up.
projects.contribution: Client project. Ostendic, led by Harsh Dubey, handled the brand structure, UX, website development and enquiry automation.

projects.name: TrueReview
projects.caution: The live demo still shows unverified figures (“2M+ reviews analysed”, “94% accuracy”, “500+ products”, “4.9 stars”) and “[User Photo]” placeholders. The site uses a screenshot of the tool itself, but visitors who open the demo will see them. Remove them from the demo.
projects.what: A demo tool that helps shoppers decide if a product is worth buying.
projects.problem: Online reviews are hard to trust, so it’s hard to know what’s actually worth buying.
projects.built: A working tool where you ask about a product and get a score based on its genuine reviews.
projects.contribution: Designed and built in-house by Ostendic as a demonstration product.

projects.name: ViralCheck
projects.what: A demo tool we built that scores a piece of content.
projects.problem: Creators guess what will work, then post and hope.
projects.built: A working tool with an AI-assisted interface that scores your content.
projects.contribution: Designed and built in-house by Ostendic as a demonstration product.

projects.name: LaunchMirror
projects.what: A demo tool that gives you a structured first read on a business idea before you commit to building it.
projects.problem: It’s easy to start building before you’ve checked whether an idea holds up. Market timing, competition and cost often get checked late, if at all.
projects.built: A working tool where you answer seven questions about your idea. You get a viability score out of 100, a market check, a short read on strengths, weaknesses and risks, and a 90-day action plan.
projects.contribution: Designed and built in-house by Ostendic as a demonstration product.
